about: Every chat prompt from Kiara's QA runs on 2 Oct 2026 (first run at 7a13967, re-test at aa1b371, round 3 at ca59363), replayed in order per session, with the expected answer-pack id of each reply (faq-id.ts). Catalog = parsed copy of the live pages at 19:59 IST. Sanitised: the first-time code word is replaced by a fake code and no real phone numbers are included. Stock = the counts the live site listed at 00:05 IST on 3 Oct (qty cap per card); C1 stock turns re-pinned to C1 stock (availability only, no counts: Shiva's ruling 3 Oct); stock values are used only to decide in/out of stock.

strains.name: White Butterfly Discus
strains.description: White body. Soft blue rim. Fine red striations.

strains.name: Blue Diamonds (Small)
strains.description: Metallic cobalt shine. The small Den classic.

strains.name: Wild Cross Curipera Discus
strains.description: Honey gold. Fine white bars. A wild Curipera cross.

strains.name: Albino Platinum
strains.description: Clean white body, soft rose blush.

strains.name: Galaxy Turquoises
strains.description: Red and blue veins. Fine striations through the body.

strains.name: Wild Red Rose
strains.description: Rose hue with wild face striations.

strains.name: Brilliant Blue Vipers
strains.description: Snakeskin. More dots than zigzag lines.

strains.name: Blue Scorpion / Blue Snakeskin / Majestic Blue
strains.description: Fine blue diamond body. Electric red lines on Majestic Blue. Red dots through the body on Snakeskin. Sparse red dots on the face and fins on Scorpion.

strains.name: Red Cover Blue Face & Rim
strains.description: Wine red body. Blue face. Blue rims.

strains.name: Panthera Snakeskin
strains.description: Fine Panthera leopard spotting. An exotic strain.
